name: submit_music
description:
Submit an instrumental or vocal music generation job and create an audio asset in the project library. Use generationType=instrumental for BGM/music beds (mureka-9), or generationType=song for an original sung song with lyrics (mureka-9.5). This tool does not place or replace timeline items; after the job completes, use track_progress to get the asset id and edit_item to place it.

External MCP spend rule: this tool costs ChatCut credits and starts an async generation job. Only call it when the user's request or confirmation clearly covers this exact generation; do not silently create extra variants, longer durations, higher quality, or additional outputs.

gender.description: Optional preferred vocal gender for song mode.

generationType.description: Generation mode. Use "instrumental" for no-vocals BGM or "song" for an original vocal song with lyrics.

lyrics.description: Lyrics for song mode, including optional [Verse] and [Chorus] markers. Maximum 5000 characters.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

prompt.description: Music and vocal direction, at most 1024 characters. Required for instrumental mode; optional for song mode (e.g. "Upbeat electronic for tech intro", "Dreamy female dream-pop vocal").
